import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 17

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/


namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture17

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 17](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, the size `b(G)` of a largest induced bipartite subgraph
satisfies `b(G) ≥ α(G) + ⌈diam(G) / 3⌉`, where `α(G)` is the independence number of `G`
and `diam(G)` is the diameter of `G`.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture17 (G : SimpleGraph α) (h : G.Connected) :
    (G.indepNum : ℝ) + ⌈(G.diam : ℝ) / 3⌉ ≤ b G := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The invariant `b G` is nonneg (it's the cast of a natural number). -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ b G := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- The independence number `α(K₂)` equals 1 (each independent set contains at most one vertex). -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)).edgeFinset.card = 1 := by decide +native

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture17

findings.description: The final anonymous test in WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture17 (lines 51–53) is documented as checking α(K₂) = 1, but its proposition is `(⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)).edgeFinset.card = 1`. This checks the number of edges, not the independence number. Both facts are true for K₂; the conjecture itself is unaffected.
findings.source_evidence: GraphConjecture17.lean, line 51: “The independence number `α(K₂)` equals 1 (each independent set contains at most one vertex).” Mathlib defines `edgeFinset` as the edge set represented as a finset, whereas `indepNum` is the maximum cardinality of an independent vertex set.
findings.suggested_fix: To retain the documented independence-number check, use `example : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)).indepNum = 1 := by rw [SimpleGraph.indep_num_eq_computable]; decide +native`. This proof was checked in the scratch file. Alternatively, change the docstring to say that K₂ has one edge.

The cited HTTP site redirects to an HTTPS endpoint that times out. Its archived landing frameset was retrieved, but the linked list.htm and comments.htm could not be accessed; subsequent Wayback requests were connection-refused. Alternative archive and literature retrieval attempts did not yield the conjecture text. The file's own docstring was not treated as independent source evidence for the main theorem.
review.notes: No mathematical defect in the main theorem was established, but source faithfulness is not certified. The Lean definitions have the expected finite-graph semantics: the relevant suprema are nonempty and bounded, and finite connected graphs avoid the diameter's disconnected/infinite default value. The division is real division and the ceiling is the integer ceiling. Scratch experiments in /workspace/review/scratch.lean verified the K₂ boundary case and found no violations among all connected graphs on at most five vertices. A sorry-free Lean proof also establishes that removing Nontrivial α gives an equivalent all-finite-connected-graphs statement: the omitted subsingleton case has diameter zero, and every independent set induces a bipartite subgraph. The first nonnegativity test is correct. No checkout files were edited.
